{{Quote|Tregga's doing life at hard labor on Akrit'tar; they caught him before he could dump a load of chak-root.|Han Solo, to Roa|<ref name="hsr" />}}
'''Tregga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked as part of an underworld crew led by [[Roa]]<ref name="hsr" /> on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In that [[Time/Legends|time]] Tregga worked alongside fellow smugglers [[Vonzel/Legends|Vonzel]] and the twins [[Lozira Briil|Lozira]] and [[Rewinda Briil]], and eventually, partners [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]],<ref name="hsr" /> who went on to great fame as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] heroes.<ref name="aoc">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref> At some point before [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], however, Tregga was captured while carrying a load of illegal [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]], and was sentenced to a life sentence of hard labor at a penal colony on [[Akrit'tar/Legends|Akrit'tar]].<ref name="hsr" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tregga was first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1979]].<ref name="hsr" /> Nearly 40 years later, a background character in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' was identified as [[Tregga]] by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''.<ref name="solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref>
